items.problem: Every zero-deferral migration trips a spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency' from Validate-UwpMigration.ps1, even when the migration is otherwise fully PASS.
items.evidence: session-log.txt TURN 33 and TURN 35 both print the WARN; there are zero defer rows (all 4 mapping rows are migrate-as-is) and the run scores 100/100.
items.skill_search: Grepped both migration scripts for 'DEFERRED' / 'No items deferred'. Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 line 268 gates the PASS on `$deferText -notmatch 'No items deferred'`; Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 lines 479-481 write `| (none) | — |` for the empty case and never emit that sentinel.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: `if ($deferredKeys.Count -eq 0) { [void]$dlines.Add('| (none) | — |') }`  vs  Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: `if ($deferText -notmatch 'No items deferred') { Write-Host "[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency" }`
items.root_cause: The bootstrap and the validator disagree on the empty-deferral sentinel. The validator's success branch is effectively unreachable via the bootstrap's own output, so the WARN fires on every no-deferral scenario.
items.proposed_fix: In Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's empty-deferral branch, also emit the literal sentinel `_No items deferred._` that the validator recognizes, so the empty case reports [PASS] instead of [WARN].
items.generalizes: Deferrals only happen when a source file touches an unsupported API. Many UWP samples touch none, so a large fraction of migrations hit the zero-deferral path and get this false warning. Removing it stops misleading agents (and human reviewers) into chasing a phantom inconsistency at the final gate on otherwise-perfect migrations.
